[[User:Kevstuff|Kevstuff]] ([[User talk:Kevstuff|talk]]) 21:11, 21 October 2026 (UTC) == External link suggestion (conflict of interest disclosed) == {{request edit}} Disclosure: I built the tools below, so I am not adding anything to the article myself and will leave the decision to other editors. Readers of this article will mostly want to know whether their own site or server is affected. Two free resources may be useful in an "External links" section, if editors think they meet [[WP:EL]]: * An open-source (MIT) script that lists every PHP installation on a server and flags PHP-FPM processes still running a replaced binary after the update: https://github.com/KyleClouthier/php2shell-check * A browser check that reads a site's public signals (headers, CMS fingerprints) and explains what to ask the host if the version is hidden: https://simgen.dev/php-patch-check . This one is on my own business site, which also offers paid help, so editors may prefer the GitHub link alone. Happy for either or neither to be used. Thanks for maintaining the article.
